verdict.rationale: Qodo documents its own programmatic surfaces: an MCP server and CLI that retrieve and resolve review findings, fetch rules, and review changes locally, plus configuration-as-code through .pr_agent.toml. These cover only a slice of what the portal does, and the OpenAPI probe found no published API spec. missing for 10: a documented public REST/HTTP API, any statement of API–UI parity, and programmatic coverage of portal configuration, governance/history dashboards, access management, integrations and onboarding.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use MCP when you want to connect Qodo Agentic Toolbox managed skills to a remote or custom agent, workflow, or application.
Manage Qodo configuration as code using a .pr\_agent.toml file at the repository, project, group, or organization level.
Review changes before opening a pull request.
